story.title: The Bell That Fell from the Sky
story.hook: At an ordinary cheerful Bell family breakfast, Bix taps a cup in a broken two-note rhythm that makes Mara remember the dying bells of Veylora; the family learns why she protects the home they have now.
story.goal: After the catastrophe separates her family, Mara must protect the new home she finds on Earth and help a Veylora refugee named Aila feel safe enough to choose what comes next.
story.central_conflict: Aila's old copper suitcase rises when a repaired Earth fixed gate rings; the quick fix could damage the possessions and markings linked to her missing little sister.
story.stakes: The moving suitcase could hurt an ordinary Earth bird nest, reveal magic to Evan and Bellfern neighbors, and make Aila lose the only family keepsakes that survived her escape.
story.theme: A home is built when people listen, protect one another, tell the truth and allow each person to choose their own path.
story.twist: The flying suitcase does not have its own mind and Bubu is not opening it; damaged copper resonates with cooling pulses of the repaired fixed station, while a separate blue glass stone holds an unexplained faint note.
story.resolution: Juno admits the copper brace made things worse; Mara offers Aila a reversible choice, and Juno, Bix, Lia, Mara and Aila test wood-and-linen damping through two station pulses before moving her luggage safely.
story.emotional_change: Mara moves from trying to protect everybody alone to making one real safe refuge and letting Aila decide. Juno moves from instant clever fixes to tested evidence and apologizing.
story.lasting_consequence: Aila voluntarily stays in a small garden guest room with her folded star drawing; her sister remains missing, Orin's next verified relay is pending, and the blue stone echoes a new unknown world.
story.why_this_episode: The family lives and laughs before a memory of civilizational loss explains why their second home on Earth matters; the first genuine refugee rescue then uses patient testing and informed choice.
story.originality_difference: An emotionally motivated, warm three-minute present-day family cold open leads to the Veylora flashback; later a non-sentient flying suitcase afterpulse crisis explores refugee consent and practical care for wildlife.

beats.visible_action: An ordinary cup clink during a sunny Bell family breakfast disturbs Mara while Evan checks the mail, Juno/Bix make a comic mistake and Lia cares for a bird.
beats.obstacle: Evan and the ordinary human family must not be exposed to unexplained magic, while Mara still carries grief.
beats.character_choice: Mara stays present for her loved ones, checks the scarred Veylora branch and allows herself to remember rather than inventing a new emergency.
beats.immediate_consequence: A domestic sound links real love in the present to the family's lost world; the screenplay enters an explicitly remembered past.
beats.because: The broken two-note sound resembles the known historic bell failure, though the cup itself is ordinary.

beats.visible_action: In Mara's memory the small Veylora flower fades and Orin shows many old records of decline near a fixed known-world station.
beats.obstacle: The Living Current has been weakening for years, and new energy skills have not healed it.
beats.character_choice: Mara asks questions and chooses observation over desperate large magic.
beats.immediate_consequence: The audience learns depletion predates any villain intervention and why other worlds were explored.
beats.because: Mara's emotional reaction to a simple breakfast sound is grounded in a long-term real loss.

beats.visible_action: A returning fixed-gate expedition brings limited hopeful samples, but an anonymous gloved operator passes a central safety restriction.
beats.obstacle: Known-world materials cannot restore all magic and the centralized bell network is vulnerable.
beats.character_choice: Mara and Elara test carefully while Orin responds to the unexpected false call.
beats.immediate_consequence: The bypass ignites a catastrophe after an existing slow ecological collapse.
beats.because: The human choice to bypass safety limits transforms a weak current into a full network disaster.

beats.visible_action: Mapped fixed gates fail while a separate uncharted tear in the sky pulls Mara and Orin away from Elara and other refugees.
beats.obstacle: The safety bell fails and Orin can barely protect two falling people.
beats.character_choice: Mara helps children; Elara stays with evacuees; Orin spends his final shield to help Mara.
beats.immediate_consequence: The pair land separately on an entirely unmapped Earth and many Veylora people are lost.
beats.because: A collapse of the known gate network triggers unchosen rifts, never a targeted Earth deportation.

beats.visible_action: Mara follows Earth water and real landmarks while Orin searches for her; they plant a Veylora cutting and wait for gradual recovery.
beats.obstacle: Neither has a mapped Earth bell or an instant limitless power refill.
beats.character_choice: Orin follows footprints to Mara and they carefully document days of environmental recovery.
beats.immediate_consequence: A small leaf grows after time, turning loss into conditional hope without solving their larger rescue.
beats.because: Earth's balanced living cycles gradually support magic renewal, unlike one specific power specialty.

beats.visible_action: The memory ends and Mara rejoins the same morning breakfast; Evan takes his postal bag, Juno keeps his school duties, and the family visits Arthur and Rose.
beats.obstacle: They have important ordinary Earth attachments and Evan and the grandparents are still unaware of magic.
beats.character_choice: Mara treats the family morning as valuable while protecting the secret and ordinary responsibilities.
beats.immediate_consequence: Bellfern feels like a real loving home with ordinary school, letters, breakfast, chores and neighbors.
beats.because: Surviving Earth gave Mara a second chance to build a family while still carrying the Veylora promise.

beats.visible_action: Mara verifies the Earth fixed gate built years after arrival and answers Orin through one working old-world relay.
beats.obstacle: The repaired route has limited capacity and cannot send an unknown traveler anywhere.
beats.character_choice: Mara checks a viable connection and asks Aila's consent before travel.
beats.immediate_consequence: Orin arranges one safe refuge journey rather than an open-ended mass evacuation.
beats.because: Aila's need for immediate safety forces family and rescue logistics to intersect.

beats.visible_action: Aila arrives from an old repaired fixed station; her worn copper suitcase rises only during Earth-gate afterpulses.
beats.obstacle: Aila fears losing the last objects she carried after being separated from her younger sister.
beats.character_choice: Mara refuses to break the case or touch it without consent even though a quick spell might look easier.
beats.immediate_consequence: An apparently comic floating suitcase turns into a real trust and privacy issue.
beats.because: The unknown afterpulse interacts with damaged travel metal, not Bubu's unknown-world bell.

beats.visible_action: Juno's first copper brace increases vibration, and Aila reveals her sister's blue glass keepsake and drawing.
beats.obstacle: The group may damage Aila's last meaningful possessions while trying to solve a public safety risk.
beats.character_choice: Juno admits the test was wrong and listens as Aila chooses which pocket may be opened.
beats.immediate_consequence: The old copper afterpulse and the blue stone are recorded as distinct problems.
beats.because: They need a gentle mechanical repair rather than a portal or an assumed map to her sister.

beats.visible_action: A new afterpulse pushes the case into the garden as Evan returns on his human postal route.
beats.obstacle: The suitcase risks being seen in a human lane and a bird nest lies under the moving case.
beats.character_choice: Mara screens the lane while children use rope and wood rather than free magic.
beats.immediate_consequence: They catch the case in a tree and protect the ordinary wildlife without exposing magic to Evan.
beats.because: The rising case creates a physical and social danger with a real price for failure.

beats.visible_action: Aila must choose between cutting away resonant copper and preserving a record of the road she took.
beats.obstacle: The quickest option could erase meaningful marks whose relevance cannot yet be proved.
beats.character_choice: Mara gives Aila real informed choice; Juno apologizes for treating the case as only broken metal.
beats.immediate_consequence: Aila agrees to a slower reversible isolation test under strict safety rules.
beats.because: Trust grows because the guest remains an active decision-maker, not cargo for the family's rescue.

beats.visible_action: Juno, Bix and Lia test wood and linen damping while Mara measures two station pulses.
beats.obstacle: A single successful pulse is not reliable evidence and copper makes the resonance worse.
beats.character_choice: Juno repeats a controlled test and preserves the glass stone separately from the old metal.
beats.immediate_consequence: The case stops floating through two afterpulses and the bird nest stays safe.
beats.because: Juno's corrected engineering, Aila's consent and Lia's observation earn the resolution together.

beats.visible_action: Aila is offered a small Earth garden room, clear choice of rest, and a truthful plan for later family searches.
beats.obstacle: The family cannot immediately recover Aila's sister or build an infinite refugee settlement.
beats.character_choice: Mara promises a safe bed and evidence-based search rather than false certainty or forced travel.
beats.immediate_consequence: Aila chooses to rest, keep her belongings and seek her sister when it is safe.
beats.because: The local goal is fulfilled while the series-wide rescue mission remains open.

beats.visible_action: Juno writes the old copper marks for Orin's next verified connection; Evan welcomes Aila as an ordinary guest.
beats.obstacle: The station relay is currently closed and Evan's understanding of magic is not yet authorized to change.
beats.character_choice: Juno stores an unsent note; Evan offers a meal and companionship rather than an interrogation.
beats.immediate_consequence: The family ends the day with a changed sense of responsibility and a real guest at the table.
beats.because: The rescue leaves continuity records while protecting Aila's consent and Evan's initial ignorance.

beats.visible_action: Bubu detects a distinct unknown-world echo from Aila's blue glass stone after the old station is off.
beats.obstacle: Bubu is tired, no destination is mapped and there is no proven safe return path tonight.
beats.character_choice: Mara deliberately refuses immediate travel and asks for careful research after everyone rests.
beats.immediate_consequence: The first rescue ends safely; a future unknown-world question opens without a fake unresolved local ending.
beats.because: The blue stone's earlier seed pays off as a possible but not confirmed uncharted-world signal.

scenes.location: Bellfern warm family kitchen; Bix delivers breakfast
scenes.scene_purpose: Introduce the entire family immediately and create curiosity from Mara reacting to an ordinary broken two-note cup clink
scenes.observable_character_action: Evan sorts letters while Juno and Bix try a serving tray and Lia notices a thirsty bird
scenes.new_information_or_change: Mara recognizes a painful sound from her Veylora past but stays with her present family

scenes.location: Bell family kitchen as a small robot trial continues
scenes.scene_purpose: Give domestic comedy real consequences and justify a flashback through Mara's memory rather than a sudden arbitrary prologue
scenes.observable_character_action: Bix drops a spoon, Juno owns the mistake, Mara touches the living Veylora cutting's old scar
scenes.new_information_or_change: Warm family laughter triggers a credible memory of the broken bells years earlier

scenes.location: Veylora old garden and endangered living plant
scenes.scene_purpose: Show the physical state of Veylora before the catastrophic attack
scenes.observable_character_action: Mara attempts weak careful magic while Orin observes a failing bell note
scenes.new_information_or_change: Long-term ecological weakness exists before any actor triggers the disaster

scenes.location: Veylora research hall and fixed mapped-world station
scenes.scene_purpose: Explain evidence that knowledge of strong magic did not heal damaged regeneration
scenes.observable_character_action: Orin checks old charts and station safety devices with Mara rather than opening unsafe roads
scenes.new_information_or_change: Maps record declining energy and limited known-world approaches to restoration

scenes.location: Veylora known-world expedition dock and family table
scenes.scene_purpose: Make the family's old bonds matter and show a believable last moment of hope
scenes.observable_character_action: Elara joins the sample checks as Mara observes ordinary growth and Orin evaluates the old route
scenes.new_information_or_change: No imported specialty power restores the Living Current; an unrequested bell begins ringing

scenes.location: Veylora central gate machinery and nearby streets
scenes.scene_purpose: Reveal only the deliberate safety bypass without leaking the hidden villain's true identity
scenes.observable_character_action: An unidentified hand changes a limit while Orin and Mara direct people away from unstable gates
scenes.new_information_or_change: The old crisis changes into an immediate bell network failure

scenes.location: Veylora evacuation bridge and uncontrollable uncharted rupture
scenes.scene_purpose: Show ordinary people and Elara matter while the family loses its known roads
scenes.observable_character_action: Mara escorts a child, Elara protects evacuees and Orin shields Mara with his remaining strength
scenes.new_information_or_change: Two members fall toward the same unknown Earth through a genuine uncontrolled rift

scenes.location: Earth creek woodland where Mara wakes alone
scenes.scene_purpose: Prove Earth has no known ancient fixed gate and that survival requires real choices
scenes.observable_character_action: Mara tests water and watches the unfamiliar humans from a distance
scenes.new_information_or_change: Mara finds no route map and must follow simple physical landmarks

scenes.location: Earth creek crossing where Orin tracks the fallen cutting
scenes.scene_purpose: Reunite separated family members through physical action rather than convenient remote magic
scenes.observable_character_action: Orin follows soil fragments and small footprints and helps Mara cross the creek
scenes.new_information_or_change: Both admit the rest of their family are still lost and choose to keep searching

scenes.location: Earth sheltered creek planting after multiple days
scenes.scene_purpose: Show the conditionally regenerative effect of Earth slowly and without inventing instant strength
scenes.observable_character_action: Mara plants the cutting and logs water and soil as Orin checks recovery day by day
scenes.new_information_or_change: A new leaf grows after time; this original plant later stays in Bellfern

scenes.location: Bellfern kitchen and front garden, returning to same morning
scenes.scene_purpose: Resolve the cold-open emotional question through a comforting family moment and school-day duties
scenes.observable_character_action: Evan offers to listen about Mara's past, Juno checks Bix and Lia gives a bird water
scenes.new_information_or_change: The present-day family remains ordinary and safe without forcing a magic disclosure

scenes.location: Arthur and Rose Bell nearby cottage
scenes.scene_purpose: Strengthen intergenerational family life with ordinary visits and real neighborhood ties
scenes.observable_character_action: Evan brings mail to Arthur while Juno repairs a hinge and Lia respects a bird nest
scenes.new_information_or_change: Grandparents remain unaware and the local Earth environment becomes emotionally valuable

scenes.location: Bell workshop and recently built fixed gate station
scenes.scene_purpose: Define two distinct door systems and verified routes with safety constraints
scenes.observable_character_action: Mara and children check the new Earth station they built after arrival
scenes.new_information_or_change: Only old known-world relay is available, not an instant anywhere door

scenes.location: Bell workshop connected to a known-world repaired relay
scenes.scene_purpose: Ground Orin's rescue request in an actual working station rather than a free phone call
scenes.observable_character_action: Mara checks paired station lights and asks Aila if she chooses the journey
scenes.new_information_or_change: Aila can travel safely but no other passengers can be promised a passage

scenes.location: Bell workshop fixed arrival room
scenes.scene_purpose: Introduce a displaced person and a consent boundary before the comedy begins
scenes.observable_character_action: Mara greets Aila, Lia brings water and Bix tests suitcase weight
scenes.new_information_or_change: Aila arrives from a known route with old possessions and fears losing them

scenes.location: Bell workshop near cooling station
scenes.scene_purpose: Make a suitcase levitation clue observable without suggesting Bubu owns the old gate
scenes.observable_character_action: Juno spots that the case lifts during pulses while Mara keeps everyone back
scenes.new_information_or_change: A station afterpulse seems tied to the case's damaged metal

scenes.observable_character_action: He clips copper to the case, makes vibration worse and stops the unsafe test
scenes.new_information_or_change: Adding more copper is the wrong repair; no omniscient inventor fixes all problems

scenes.location: Bell workshop safe table and Aila's keepsakes
scenes.scene_purpose: Shift from a funny prop to Aila's emotional and ethical stakes
scenes.observable_character_action: Aila lets Lia see the drawing and blue stone only after being asked
scenes.new_information_or_change: Aila lost her younger sister, and the stone has a separate unclear sound

scenes.location: Bell workshop garden hatch and stairs
scenes.scene_purpose: Create physical urgency through the next cooling pulse and an open hatch
scenes.observable_character_action: Mara blocks the danger and children collect soft rope instead of using instant portals
scenes.new_information_or_change: The case drifts into the daylight beyond the private workshop

scenes.location: Bell family rear garden near public lane
scenes.scene_purpose: Protect Evan's initial knowledge boundary under rising pressure
scenes.observable_character_action: Juno diverts Evan with an ordinary explanation while Mara screens the garden
scenes.new_information_or_change: Evan sees no impossible flying suitcase, but the case reaches the tree

scenes.location: Bell garden apple tree above occupied bird nest
scenes.scene_purpose: Force problem-solving around living Earth ecology and a vulnerable nest
scenes.observable_character_action: Lia watches the birds; Aila, Mara, Juno and Bix lower the case with rope
scenes.new_information_or_change: The case is caught but will rise at the next cooling note

scenes.location: Covered garden bench with Aila's suspended case
scenes.scene_purpose: Make owner consent matter as much as speed of repair
scenes.observable_character_action: Aila rejects cutting a final memory and agrees to a slower reversible test
scenes.new_information_or_change: The family must preserve evidence while stopping a risk to their neighbors

scenes.location: Garden safe bench and clocked gate afterpulse
scenes.scene_purpose: Earn the first successful physical test after Juno's earlier mistake
scenes.observable_character_action: Juno uses wood and linen while Bix measures and Lia checks nearby wildlife
scenes.new_information_or_change: The case trembles but stays on the table during one known pulse

scenes.location: Workshop safe table after repeated pulse
scenes.scene_purpose: Verify the fix, then transform a displaced stranger's fear into tentative trust
scenes.observable_character_action: The group repeats the test and preserves Aila's copper marks in a sketch
scenes.new_information_or_change: The suitcase becomes safe and the local physical problem is solved

scenes.location: Bell family small garden guest room
scenes.scene_purpose: Offer a specific limited refuge rather than unrealistic mass relocation
scenes.observable_character_action: Mara shows Aila a private bed and choice to lock the door from inside
scenes.new_information_or_change: Aila chooses to stay one night and starts feeling safe

scenes.location: Bell garden refuge path and personal ledger
scenes.scene_purpose: Create an honest future plan without promising a sister's location
scenes.observable_character_action: Juno hands Aila the copper drawing and she chooses rest before searching
scenes.new_information_or_change: Aila's consent and belongings become part of the continuing rescue record

scenes.location: Bell workshop with quiet fixed station
scenes.scene_purpose: Prevent a false magic phone call or unsupported proof from a metal fitting
scenes.observable_character_action: Juno stores his message for Orin until a real line opens
scenes.new_information_or_change: The old station is silent and the blue stone remains unresolved

scenes.location: Bell family kitchen at ordinary dinner
scenes.scene_purpose: Give the first rescue its emotional payoff and protect Evan's ignorance
scenes.observable_character_action: Evan welcomes Aila without interrogation and Bix supplies a small joke
scenes.new_information_or_change: Aila joins the table as a guest by choice, not rescued cargo

scenes.location: Bell guest room and silent workshop at night
scenes.scene_purpose: Pay off the seeded glass stone without confusing it with station afterpulses
scenes.observable_character_action: Bubu hears an unfamiliar tone while Lia checks the known station is silent
scenes.new_information_or_change: An uncharted signal might exist, but no portal is possible tonight

scenes.location: Bell workshop home anchor and quiet night sky
scenes.scene_purpose: Close local story while opening only a bounded series mystery
scenes.observable_character_action: Mara refuses immediate travel and promises research before any crossing
scenes.new_information_or_change: Bubu says another world is calling; the family has a home and a question

setup_payoffs.specific_clue: Mara's old scarred Veylora cutting and Orin's historical research document weak regeneration long before the central safety override.
setup_payoffs.earned_resolution: After days in Earth soil the branch gains a genuine new leaf, supporting slow environmental renewal rather than instant spells.

setup_payoffs.specific_clue: The Earth fixed station visibly pulses in cooling cycles after one verified old-world traveler crosses.
setup_payoffs.earned_resolution: The copper brace amplifies the afterpulse in Aila's case, proving why the case rises without help from Bubu.

setup_payoffs.specific_clue: Juno's copper clip makes resonance worse, and the luggage settles away from active station pulses.
setup_payoffs.earned_resolution: The corrected wood and linen insulation survives two repeated afterpulse measurements while Aila's keepsake stays intact.

setup_payoffs.specific_clue: Aila's little blue glass stone sings separately from the damaged old station copper while Bubu cannot yet name the sound.
setup_payoffs.earned_resolution: After the fixed station is fully silent Bubu hears an independent specific unknown-world echo, but he is too tired and no safe destination is verified.

character_arcs.initial_state: Mara thinks the safest response is to solve refugee emergencies quickly before ordinary people see the magic.
character_arcs.internal_need: She needs to give the person being helped real control rather than protecting them by taking away their choices.
character_arcs.costly_decision: Mara risks a longer and harder test rather than cutting a damaged keepsake without Aila's informed agreement.
character_arcs.final_state: Mara listens before acting and offers one real safe night with a truthful but limited promise to keep searching.

character_arcs.initial_state: Juno believes a quick clever device can fix problems before he needs to check every part of the system.
character_arcs.internal_need: He must accept responsibility for errors and learn to verify a hypothesis without putting someone else's memories at risk.
character_arcs.costly_decision: He admits his copper brace made the case rise and delays the repair until two separate safe tests confirm the solution.
character_arcs.final_state: Juno checks his solution and records evidence instead of treating his first successful test as proof of perfection.

character_arcs.initial_state: Aila expects help to mean surrendering the only suitcase and final keepsakes from her missing younger sister.
character_arcs.internal_need: She needs safety with dignity, choice and a plan grounded in facts rather than a promise that cannot yet be kept.
character_arcs.costly_decision: She permits a careful reversible repair and accepts rest on Earth even though she cannot immediately search for her sister.
character_arcs.final_state: Aila keeps her belongings and chooses a safe garden room while agreeing to verify future routes before traveling again.

character_arcs.initial_state: Lia wants to help at once and worries that the moving case may hurt the bird nest in the family garden.
character_arcs.internal_need: She must use patient observation and ask for consent instead of assuming she can understand every animal or stranger.
character_arcs.costly_decision: She delays the fast retrieval until birds are clear and waits for Aila's permission before opening the keepsake pocket.
character_arcs.final_state: Lia becomes a trusted helper whose care includes wildlife and the guest's private possessions.

continuity_deltas.before: Veylora living branch barely alive after catastrophe and Earth unknown on maps
continuity_deltas.after: A Veylora branch regenerates over several Earth days and later lives in the Bellfern family garden, with limits noted

continuity_deltas.before: No gate existed on Earth when Orin and Mara arrived accidentally
continuity_deltas.after: Many years later a verified fixed Earth station connects to only a few safely repaired OLD-world stations and requires cooldown

continuity_deltas.before: Displaced Veylora refugee found by Orin with no safe room and belongings at risk
continuity_deltas.after: Aila chooses a small Bellfern garden guest room, retains the star drawing and blue stone, and has no confirmed route to her sister

continuity_deltas.before: Old copper fitting makes Aila's case lift during station cooling pulses and Juno's first copper brace worsens the effect
continuity_deltas.after: Wood and linen isolate the fitting through two afterpulses while Juno keeps Aila-approved copies of the copper marks

continuity_deltas.before: Aila's blue glass stone emits a faint unexplained note and is distinct from the fixed-station copper afterpulse
continuity_deltas.after: Bubu hears one new uncharted-world echo from the stone, but no destination is mapped and no portal has been opened

creative_axes: A dual-time-scale pilot that connects generation-long Veylora decay to gradual Earth renewal through one rescued tree branch.
A non-sentient flying suitcase and controlled mechanical afterpulse used to explore refugee consent instead of arbitrary fantasy danger.
A postman father and unaware paternal grandparents preserve a believable ordinary Earth family life while secret rescue is handled responsibly.
A locally completed shelter story paired with a separate unexplored sound that does not grant immediate teleportation.
editorial_questions: Does the voluntary old-world station crossing require any further gate-rights confirmation before Aila can enter the Earth workshop?
Are Aila and Elara permitted to appear with new faces or voices in production before separate owner asset approval?
Does Evan remain genuinely unaware of magic throughout the garden chase without being made implausibly inattentive?
Are the two old-station afterpulses and the independent blue-stone unknown echo clearly separated in audience understanding?
Does the journey from a major civilization catastrophe to one refugee's simple safety need produce a satisfying first-episode payoff?
Are speech density and physical movement per 10s shot sufficient for real 45-minute A2 listening and animated performance?
